text:
emma: @here Quick heads-up: Harbor-3 (model_id=harbor-3) is GA on Hosted API today. Streaming v3 and tool-calling v3 are enabled across hosted regions. Docs & migration: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/harbor-3 :tada:

emma: Minimal curl example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"harbor-3","input":"Extract action items","stream":true,"tool_call":true}'
```

emma: Important breaking-note: `tool_input` has been renamed to `tool_args` and tool outputs must conform to the new schema. Non-conforming outputs will fall back to plain text. Strict validation opt-in via `?validation=strict`. Migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/tools-v2-to-v3

raj: Can Dedicated customers pin older variants during rollout?

emma: Yes — Console: Settings -> Models -> Pin, or API with header `x-redwood-model: harbor-2@<version>`. No downtime expected.

infra-bot: deploy: harbor-3-stream-v3 canary rolled to ap-southeast-1 at 1813571228; monitoring CPU/GPU and token churn.

ops-lead: Defaults for docs: 200 concurrent streams/org, 65k token cap/stream. Support can approve increases per customer justification.

support: Added support KB "Harbor-3 GA: common issues" and canned reply. Also flagged escalation tag #harbor-3-ga in playbook.

emma: We'll post a customer-facing GA banner and an internal rollout dashboard link in Console -> Deployments -> Harbor-3. Post-GA check-in at 16:00 PT. Ping me for urgent issues. :rocket:
